When possible, push with them to get more value. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 0:30 minutes 3:00 minutes after its last capture Baseline Experience Experience Scaling 280 Experience +4 Experience per minute (*) (*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute. Instead of attacking enemies with Basic Attacks, Siege Giants throw stones at them. These stones can be dodged, so it is possible to capture them without taking any damage. Once captured, they are capable of damaging enemy Structures without getting in their range. Siege Giants deal 100% bonus damage to Structures.

sections.title: Bruiser Camp
sections.text: This type of Mercenary Camp features 3 Knights and 1 Wizard. Once captured, it spawns the same units fighting for your team in the corresponding lane. When possible, push with them to get more value. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 0:30 minutes 4:00 minutes after its last capture Baseline Experience Experience Scaling 450 Experience +9 Experience per minute (*) (*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute. Right after being captured and while in lane, the Wizard creates a Spell Armor field around him which reduces some of the damage taken by Minions, Mercenaries, and Heroes within range. Avoid fighting the enemy team if they still have a Wizard helping them!

sections.title: Map Objective
sections.text:
The signature Objective of Dragon Shire consists of Shrines that reward a Dragon Knight. Heroes can claim Shrines to unlock the Dragon Altar in the middle lane, and then an allied Hero can summon the Dragon Knight and pilot it as a Vehicle. Vehicles are Unstoppable. Capturing a Shrine takes 4 seconds if neutral, or 8 seconds if the enemy team has control over it. Summoning the Dragon Knight from the statue in the middle lane takes 3 seconds. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 1:30 minutes 2:00 minutes after the Dragon Knight dies

Control the Shrines There are two shrines your team needs to control to activate the Dragon Knight's statue. Free the Dragon Knight While activated, bring a hero to the statue to free the Dragon Knight from his prison! Devastate Enemy Forts Use the Dragon Knight's immense power to level enemy forts! Once claimed, the Dragon Knight lasts for 55 seconds, plus 2 seconds for each minute of Game Time that has passed. The player controlling the Dragon Knight has access to a dedicated set of Abilities and can decide where to go.

sections.title: Dragon Knight
sections.text: The following Abilities can be used by the player who is controlling the Dragon Knight.

sections.title: Flame Breath
sections.text: Flame Breath [Q] Dragon Knight Cooldown: 6 seconds Breathe a cone of flame, dealing 85 (+12 per minute) damage and burn the area of effect for an additional 160 (+16 per minute) damage over 4 seconds. Flame Breath is best used to clear enemy Minions or, if there are no enemy Minions to clear, to hit as many enemy Structures as possible.

sections.title: Savage Charge
sections.text: Savage Charge [W] Dragon Knight Cooldown: 10 seconds After a short delay, charge an enemy Hero to knock them back and deal 450 (+17 per minute) damage. Savage Charge can be used to stop the best enemy Hero at defending the Dragon Knight from attacking you while pushing, to peel for your team while the enemy team is trying to get a kill, or to crowd control the enemy Hero with the best save tool when your team is going for a kill. You should avoid using Shadow Charge on enemy Heroes who have mobility tools because the Dragon Knight will follow them with Shadow Charge and either end up in a dangerous position or, if they hide behind their Gate while Side Walls are still up, be stuck mid-animation without being able to use Basic Attacks.

sections.title: Rubble Maker
sections.text: Rubble Maker Dragon Knight Increases damage to Structures and Minions by 100%. Reduce damage from Structures by 60%. The Dragon Knight explodes on death, knocking back nearby enemies. Rubble Maker is a Trait which makes the Dragon Knight particularly annoying to deal with. Structures and Minions take increased damage from the Dragon Knight, and the Dragon Knight takes reduced damage from Structures. Furthermore, the Dragon Knight explodes on death, Knocking back nearby enemies. ! How to use Vehicles Vehicles have two resources: Health and duration. If they time out with high Health, it means you played too safe. If they get destroyed while there is still a lot of duration remaining, it means you played too aggressive. As a general rule, you want to keep the percentage values of Health and duration balanced. When pushing with a won Objective, you should still avoid being caught alone and not fight when outnumbered, especially when going for Keeps. If your Vehicle gets destroyed deep in the enemy territory, you will not be able to reach a safe area before getting killed unless you have a lot of mobility. In the early game, when multiple enemy Forts are still up, Vehicles can also be used as a distraction, not just for pushing directly. While they clear enemy Minions and threaten enemy Structures, the rest of the team can push in another lane. The enemy team will have to split for defending multiple lanes at the same time.

sections.title: Core Ability
sections.text: Every 6 seconds, the Core will throw 2 Boulders at a nearby enemy Hero. Heroes hit are turned to stone, damaged for 5% of their maximum Health, and Stunned for 1.75 seconds.

sections.title: Win Conditions
sections.text: To win the game on Dragon Shire, you should count on any of the following win conditions: Map Objective, Siege Camp plus Bruiser Camp, Split-push.

sections.title: Tips and Tricks
sections.text: On this Map, due to the Objective taking a long time to be won, you can use the Healing Fountain on cooldown instead of saving it for when the Objective spawns. If your Hero has an Ability which allows them to jump over impassable terrain, you can use it to quickly enter or exit from a Shrine. Choose when to contest a Shrine and when to retreat depending on which team has an advantage in that area. If they commit top, try to get bottom (and vice versa). Heroes with percent damage (such as Drain Hope by Leoric) are the best for defending from enemy Vehicles. In case that is your Offlaner and it is early game, you may want to send someone else to soak in the lane they left. Remember that Cursed Bullet by Greymane and Sleep Dart by Ana cannot hit Vehicles. If your team has a Hero with a powerful Quest that requires hitting enemy Heroes (for example Berserker on Zul'jin), you could let the enemy team get an early game Dragon Knight to easily get Quest stacks while defending from it. When piloting the Dragon Knight, you should generally use: Fire Breath [Q] for clearing enemy Minions and/or to damage enemy Structures (prioritize Minions, and ideally do both things at the same time); and Savage Charge [W] to Knockback the best enemy Hero at defending the Dragon Knight, to peel for your team, or to interrupt a powerful channeled Ability. When defending your Structures from the enemy Dragon Knight, if you ever get targeted by Savage Charge [W], you can use Unstoppable to counter it or mobility tools for dragging the Dragon Knight deeper into your territory. See our Map Guides page for further information »

sections.title: Introduction
sections.text: Garden of Terror is a 3-lane Map belonging to the Nexus universe. The signature Objective of this Map are Seeds required to get Garden Terrors. One per lane, the Garden Terrors will fight alongside the team who gets 3 Seeds, temporarily disabling enemy Structures on their path.

sections.title: Draft Strategy
sections.text: Prefer Heroes for clearing Mercenary Camps Double Bruiser Effects relying on impassable terrain Gankers Global presence Poke tools for Objective Strong late game Siege damage for Structures Split-push Tools for solo-capturing the Objective Vision tools Avoid Weak late game Quests to stack on Heroes See our Garden of Terror Tier List page for further information »

sections.title: Lane Assignments
sections.text: Here you can find one or more formations that are viable on this Map. Keep in mind that positions in lane are not strict and will often change based on the situation.

sections.title: Formation 1-1-3
sections.text: A good formation for Garden of Terror is 1-1-3: 3 Heroes cover the side lane where the allied Bruiser Camp is or, alternatively, the side lane near the next Objective; 1 Hero covers the middle lane; 1 Hero, the Offlaner, covers the side lane far away from the next Objective.

sections.title: Formation 1-3-1
sections.text: A good formation for Garden of Terror is 1-3-1: 1 Hero, preferably ranged, covers the lane where the enemy Siege Camp is; 3 Heroes cover the middle lane; 1 Hero, the Offlaner, covers the other side lane.

sections.title: Map Strategy
sections.text: When possible, send a Hero with mobility to scout the enemy Bruiser Camp. If the enemy team is clearing it, start clearing the allied Siege Camp in the same lane and capture it about 15 seconds after the enemy team captures their Bruiser Camp, so that Siege Giants will help you while defending the Fort. At 0:30 or whenever available, start clearing the allied Siege Camp in the middle lane and capture it as soon as possible. To make this Mercenary Camp join the lane behind allied Minions, capture it at 0:42 minutes or 12 seconds after a wave of Minions spawned. At 0:45 minutes or right after capturing the allied Siege Camp in the middle lane, start clearing the allied Bruiser Camp in the side lane and capture it as soon as possible. To make this Mercenary Camp join the lane in front of allied Minions, capture it at 1:12 minutes or 12 seconds after a wave of Minions spawned. At 1:45 minutes or 30-40 seconds before the next Objective phase, if the allied Siege Camp in the side lane is NOT in the same lane as the next Seed location and you did not use it in response to the enemy Bruiser Camp, start clearing the allied Siege Camp in the side lane and capture it as soon as possible. To make this Mercenary Camp join the lane behind allied Minions, capture it at 2:12 minutes or 12 seconds after a wave of Minions spawned. If you want to contest the next Seed, be there in time with 4 Heroes while 1 Hero defends enemy Mercenaries and then joins the team at the Objective. If it is the first Seed of the game, the Offlaner can keep soaking. If you want to give the next Seed, poke with a couple of Heroes and let the rest of your team push in the opposite lane from the Objective. When you reach 3 Seeds, push side lanes. Do not forget to soak in this phase. If you lose the Objective, try to save as many Forts and Keeps as possible. In case the enemy team is playing grouped, however, you must immediately retreat from the lane near them while your teammates get value elsewhere.

sections.title: Mercenary Camps
sections.text: As shown in the image below, Garden of Terror has a total of 6 Mercenary Camps: 1 Siege Camp (green icon) on the left side of the top lane; 1 Bruiser Camp (blue icon) on the right side of the top lane; 2 Siege Camps (green icon) in the middle lane; 1 Bruiser Camp (blue icon) on the left side of the bottom lane; 1 Siege Camp (green icon) on the right side of the bottom lane. Mercenary Camps on Garden of Terror disappear from the battlefield once the Garden Terrors begin spawning (unless their Mercenaries are in combat) and reappear only after all Garden Terrors have been killed.

sections.title: Siege Camp
sections.text: This type of Mercenary Camp features 2 Siege Giants. Once captured, it spawns the same units fighting for your team in the corresponding lane. When possible, push with them to get more value. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 0:30 minutes 3:00 minutes after its last capture Baseline Experience Experience Scaling 280 Experience +4 Experience per minute (*) (*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute. Instead of attacking enemies with Basic Attacks, Siege Giants throw stones at them. These stones can be dodged, so it is possible to capture them without taking any damage. Once captured, they are capable of damaging enemy Structures without getting in their range. Siege Giants deal 100% bonus damage to Structures.

sections.title: Bruiser Camp
sections.text: This type of Mercenary Camp features 3 Knights and 1 Wizard. Once captured, it spawns the same units fighting for your team in the corresponding lane. When possible, push with them to get more value. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 0:30 minutes 4:00 minutes after its last capture Baseline Experience Experience Scaling 450 Experience +9 Experience per minute (*) (*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute. Right after being captured and while in lane, the Wizard creates a Spell Armor field around him which reduces some of the damage taken by Minions, Mercenaries, and Heroes within range. Avoid fighting the enemy team if they still have a Wizard helping them!

sections.title: Map Objective
sections.text:
The signature Objective of Garden of Terror consists of Seeds required to get Garden Terrors. In order to collect a Seed, Heroes have to channel for 6 seconds. Seeds also spawn a Regeneration Globe when collected. The first team who gets 3 Seeds will spawn a Garden Terror per lane. You should push with them once they reach enemy Structures and start hitting them. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 2:30 minutes from 0:50 to 1:20 minutes after collecting a Seed, from 1:30 to 2:00 minutes after all Garden Terrors die

Fight the Shamblers At night, Shamblers will rise from the gardens. Collect Seeds Kill the Shamblers and collect seeds for your team. Control Garden Terror With 100 seeds, control a garden terror and destroy your enemies! Seeds can spawn in 6 possible locations, with each Objective phase having only 1 Seed active. The spawning rules are: the first Seed is always bottom-left or bottom-right; a Seed cannot be in the same row as the previous one; 3 consecutive Seeds are always in 3 different columns.

sections.title: Seeds Sequences
sections.text: Once you know the second Seed's location, it is possible to predict all other Seed's locations. bottom-left, top-right, bottom-middle, top-left, bottom-right, top-middle; bottom-right, top-left, bottom-middle, top-right, bottom-left, top-middle; bottom-left, top-middle, bottom-right, top-left, bottom-middle, top-right; bottom-right, top-middle, bottom-left, top-right, bottom-middle, top-left.

sections.title: Garden Terror
sections.text: While approaching enemy Structures, Garden Terrors spawn an Overgrowth that takes damage equal to 10% of its maximum Health every second and disables enemy Structures as long as it is alive, for up to 10 seconds. When attacking, use it to push or even dive when possible. When defending, destroy it as quickly as possible to enable your Structures again.

sections.title: Core Ability
sections.text: Every 5 seconds, the Core shoots a Seed under a nearby enemy Hero. When the seed explodes, Heroes inside are Polymorphed for 3 seconds.

sections.title: Win Conditions
sections.text: To win the game on Garden of Terror, you should count on any of the following win conditions: Map Objective, Split-push.

sections.title: Tips and Tricks
sections.text: Use the first Healing Fountain (2-minute cooldown) before 0:30 minutes because the first Objective on this Map activates at 2:30 minutes, so you will have it back in time for that. Depending on where the next Seed is, you should decide if you want to contest it or not. Seeds on the enemy side of the battlefield are harder to contest whereas Seeds on your side of the battlefield are easier to contest. If you want to contest the next Seed, be there in time with 4 Heroes while 1 Hero defends enemy Mercenaries and then joins the team at the Objective. If it is the first Seed of the game, the Offlaner can keep soaking. If you are not ready to contest or capture a Seed, do not kill the Shamblers that are defending it. They will slow down the enemy team while your team gets ready. To capture a Seed as quick as possible, one Hero should distract the Shamblers by taking aggro and another Hero should click on the Seed. Garden Terrors spawn an Overgrowth that disables enemy Structures. When attacking, use it to dive when possible. When defending, destroy it to enable your Structures again. Global Heroes should ideally take care of the lane that is farther away from the next Objective location, so that they can use their global tool to quickly join their team during the next Objective phase. See our Map Guides page for further information »

sections.title: Introduction
sections.text: Hanamura Temple is a 2-lane Map belonging to the Overwatch universe. The signature Objective of this Map is a Payload. Once successfully escorted to its final destination, it deals damage to enemy Structures. On this Map, you can also find the Sentinel Camp, a unique Mercenary Camp that deals a lot of damage to enemy Heroes and Structures.

sections.title: Draft Strategy
sections.text: Prefer Heroes for clearing Mercenary Camps Gankers Quests to stack on Heroes Siege damage for Structures Sustain damage/healing Avoid Effects relying on impassable terrain See our Hanamura Temple Tier List page for further information »

sections.title: Lane Assignments
sections.text: Here you can find one or more formations that are viable on this Map. Keep in mind that positions in lane are not strict and will often change based on the situation.

sections.title: Formation 1-4
sections.text: The go-to formation for Hanamura Temple is 1-4: 1 Hero, the Offlaner, covers the top lane; 4 Heroes cover the bottom lane.

sections.title: Map Strategy
sections.text: At 0:30 minutes or whenever available (even during the Objective phase), start clearing the allied Samurai Camp and capture it as soon as possible. At 0:45 minutes or whenever available (even during the Objective phase), start clearing the allied Fortification Camp and capture it as soon as possible. Do not forget to pick up the Turret! Whenever the enemy Samurai reaches your Structures, you may need multiple Heroes to defend from it, especially if enemy Heroes are pushing with it. Alternatively, you can counter-push in the opposite lane with the allied Samurai. If the allied Samurai Camp and the allied Fortification Camp are taken, you can capture any Recon Camp that is neutral or controlled by the enemy team. This will make it harder for the enemy team to freely move around the battlefield. After 3:00 minutes or whenever the Objective is active, prevent the enemy team from delivering the Payload when it gets closer to the end of its path, so that they cannot deal more damage than you to Structures and thus cause you to lose the trade. If the allied Samurai Camp and the allied Fortification Camp are taken, you can escort the Payload to its destination, not necessarily by committing all Heroes. Choose how many Heroes to use depending on how fast you need to escort the Payload, how dangerous it is, and what else your team can do to get value on the battlefield.

sections.title: Mercenary Camps
sections.text:
As shown in the image below, Hanamura Temple has a total of 6 Mercenary Camps: 1 Fortification Camp (purple icon) on the left side of the top lane; 1 Samurai Camps (red icon) on the right side of the top lane; 1 Recon Camp (blue icon) near the center of top lane; 1 Recon Camp (blue icon) near the center of bottom lane; 1 Fortification Camp (purple icon) on the right side of the bottom lane; 1 Samurai Camp (red icon) on the left side of the bottom lane. Mercenary Camps on Hanamura Temple are always active, even when the Payload is up or during a bombardment.

Mercenary Camps indicated with a red icon are immune to Bribe effects.

sections.title: Recon Camp
sections.text: This type of Mercenary Camp features 3 Henchmen. Once captured, it behaves like a Watch Tower. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 0:30 minutes 1 second after its last capture Baseline Experience Experience Scaling 540 Experience +24 Experience per minute (*) (*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute. Due to how the Recon Camp works, simply capturing it will not result into a net gain of Experience. The enemy team captures it, get Experience, then you capture it back, and get a similar amount of Experience. To receive a net gain of Experience, let the enemy team clear it and invade at the last second.

sections.title: Fortification Camp
sections.text: This type of Mercenary Camp features 1 Mechanic and 1 Turret. Once captured, it leaves a Turret on the ground that can be collected by allied or enemy Heroes. Always kill the Mechanic first because he can repair the Turret while below 80% Health. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 0:30 minutes 2:30 minutes after its last capture Baseline Experience Experience Scaling 460 Experience +10 Experience per minute

sections.title: Turret
sections.text: Turrets are consumable items that, when put on the ground, deal damage to an enemy within range, prioritizing Heroes and dealing double damage to Minions. Since they count as Mercenaries, you can empower them with some Talents (such as Mercenary Queen by Sylvanas). Turret [F] Item Place a Turret that rapidly attacks nearby enemies for 90 damage per second. Turret lasts for 45 seconds, or until destroyed.

sections.title: Samurai Camp
sections.text: This type of Mercenary Camp features 1 Samurai. Once captured, it spawns the same unit fighting for your team in the corresponding lane. When possible, push with it to get more value. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 0:30 minutes 2:30 minutes after its last capture Baseline Experience Experience Scaling 530 Experience +15 Experience per minute (*) (*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute. While in combat, the Samurai will attack any foe in range and execute his signature move: Horizontal Slash (8-second cooldown). If you are a ranged Hero, stay distant and just step back as soon as you see Horizontal Slash's indicator on the ground. If you are a melee Hero, stay close and just walk through the Sentinel because Horizontal Slash only deals damage in the frontal area. Due to being Elite, this Mercenary Camp is immune to Bribe effects (such as Covert Mission by Nova).

sections.title: Watch Towers
sections.text:
Hanamura Temple features 2 Watch Tower in the form of Recon Camps: they are located in the middle area, one near the top lane and another one near the bottom lane. If a team controls both Watch Towers and the Payload is not active, it impossible to walk from a side to another without being seen because there is a hole in the center of the battlefield, where the Payload spawns.

Securing a Watch Tower provides your team with greater vision, allowing you to keep an eye on enemy movements in that part of the battlefield. This unique type of Watch Tower can be captured only after killing all the Henchmen who are guarding it, similarly to Mercenary Camps. Immediately after being occupied, they become attackable by the enemy team again. Contrary to the standard type of Watch Tower, Recon Camps do not become neutral after 45 seconds. Watch Towers controlled by the enemy team are extremely dangerous, especially when there are bushes nearby, therefore you should think twice before contesting them. If you do not have mobility tools at your disposal and your teammates are not nearby to help you, you should definitely not try to capture a Watch Tower as you will only risk dying for no reason. Staying alive is more important than getting vision.

sections.title: Map Objective
sections.text:
The signature Objective of Hanamura Temple consists of 1 Payload. Securing the area around the Payload allows your team to move it. Once delivered, it causes a barrage to start, dealing damage to enemy Structures, and gives a Regeneration Globe to all the winning Heroes nearby. The countdown for its respawn will start after the last shot has been fired. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 3:00 minutes 3:00 minutes after the Payload is delivered

Single Payload At regular intervals, a payload spawns at the center of the battleground that can be contested by both teams. Escort Payload Stand next to the payload and move it to its destination. Prevent the enemy team from trying to do the same. Bombard your Enemy Once a team escorts the payload to its destination, it will fire upon the enemy's forts.

sections.title: Payload
sections.text: You can make the Payload go faster by escorting it with multiple Heroes. Adding a second Hero will increase that value by about 10%. The presence of a third Hero will add 10% to that. This bonus is capped at 3 Heroes, so any additional Hero after that will not contribute to speeding up its delivery. Heroes Movement Speed 1 50% 2 60% 3 70% Leaving the area will cause the Payload to stop moving, but it will not go back unless enemy Heroes start escorting it uncontested. Dedicating a single Hero is the most efficient way to escort the Payload whereas dedicating 3 Heroes is the fastest way to escort it. Misha counts as 1 Hero, Gall does not count. There are 3 predetermined Payload's paths: path A, path B, and path C. The time it takes for the Payload to reach its destination changes based on them (see table below). Each time a team delivers a Payload, their part of the path gets upgraded to the next tier. After all the upgrades for that team, it goes back to the first tier. The enemy Payload's path being upgraded does not influence the allied Payload's path in any way. Heroes Path A Path B Path C 1 33 seconds 23 seconds 36 seconds 2 27 seconds 19 seconds 29 seconds 3 23 seconds 16 seconds 25 seconds

sections.title: Path A
sections.text: The first path (letter A) is vertical and requires the corresponding team to escort the Payload through one of the side lanes after walking around one of the Recon Camps. The final destination of this path will always be in the same lane where the enemy Sentinel goes.

sections.title: Path B
sections.text: The second path (letter B) is bent in the enemy territory of the enemy team, passing nearby the enemy Fortification Camp. This change makes it slightly harder for the winning team to successfully escort the Payload again as the zone is surrounded by enemy Structures, especially if the nearby Fort has not been taken down yet. In particular, the enemy team will have access to 1-2 Healing Fountains whereas the winning team will not have any of them nearby.

sections.title: Path C
sections.text: The third path (letter C) is also bent in the enemy territory, but this time goes near one of the Recon Camps and then proceeds through the wide area near the enemy Sentinel Camp. This change makes it harder for the winning team to secure the Objective another time as the final destination is exactly in the middle of the enemy Keeps. The enemy team will have access to 2 Healing Fountains whereas the winning team will be too deep in the enemy territory to use them.

sections.title: Barrage
sections.text: A successful delivery results in 12 shots being fired over 15 seconds. Missiles deal 2280 damage (not scaling) to enemy Structures. Cores take 20% less damage from Payload's shots. When being fired, Payload's shots will target Structures in the lane where enemy Structures have the least amount of damage taken in total. Forts and Keeps will only be targeted if the respective Towers and Gates have been destroyed. Cores will only be targeted if all Towers, Gates, Forts, and Keeps have been destroyed. In the late game, if the only Structure left is the Core with 100% Health and 100% Shield, a barrage will bring it down to around 50% Health remaining.

sections.title: Core Ability
sections.text: Every 8 seconds, the Core fires 2 volleys of Missiles around it, dealing 5% maximum Health as damage to enemy Heroes and Slowing them by 70% for 1.25 seconds.

sections.title: Win Conditions
sections.text: To win the game on Hanamura Temple, you should count on any of the following win conditions: Map Objective, Sentinel Camp. Try to store Turrets for the late game.

sections.title: Tips and Tricks
sections.text: Use the first Healing Fountain (2-minute cooldown) before 1:00 minute because the first Objective on this Map activates at 3:00 minutes, so you will have it back in time for that. You can bait the Samurai's Horizontal Slash in the direction you want as it targets the closest Hero. When capturing it, bait it towards the wall so that allied Heroes do not risk taking damage from it. When both the Samurai Camp and the allied Fortification Camp are available, prioritize the Samurai Camp. This way it will go on cooldown sooner and thus respawn sooner, allowing you to capture it again earlier. Due to how the Recon Camp works, simply capturing it will not result into a net gain of Experience. The enemy team captures it, get Experience, then you capture it back, and get a similar amount of Experience. To receive a net gain of Experience, let the enemy team clear it and invade at the last second. Even if your team almost delivered the Payload at its final destination, if the enemy team has an advantage, you should immediately retreat and try again later, unless it is the game-winning Payload for the enemy team. If your team is doing fine, you can store Turrets for the late game instead of using them in the early game. If you are going to die, however, place them on the ground before they kill you and steal them. At high level of play it is common to completely ignore the Objective area and get value elsewhere by pushing because the Payload takes too much time to be delivered and it does not deal that much damage to enemy Structures. See our Map Guides page for further information »

sections.title: Introduction
sections.text: Haunted Mines is a 2-lane Map belonging to the Nexus universe. The signature Objective of this Map is an Undead Army dropping Cursed Skulls. The team who collects more Cursed Skulls will get a stronger Grave Golem, the other team will get a weaker one.

sections.title: Draft Strategy
sections.text: Prefer Siege damage for Structures Sustain damage/healing Effects relying on impassable terrain Heroes for clearing Mercenary Camps Point control for Sapper Camps Moderate waveclear Avoid Quests to stack on Heroes Weak early game See our Haunted Mines Tier List page for further information »

sections.title: Lane Assignments
sections.text: Here you can find one or more formations that are viable on this Map. Keep in mind that positions in lane are not strict and will often change based on the situation.

sections.title: Formation 1-4
sections.text: The go-to formation for Haunted Mines is 1-4: 1 Hero, the Offlaner, covers the top lane; 4 Heroes cover the bottom lane.

sections.title: Map Strategy
sections.text: At 0:30 minutes or whenever available, start clearing the Sapper Camp in the lane your 4-man is and capture it as soon as possible. Watch out for invades! If your team does not have point control tools, go for the farthest Sapper Camp from the enemy 4-man. At 2:20 minutes or 20-30 seconds before the Undead Army spawns in the Mines, start clearing the allied Siege Camp and capture it slightly before the Undead Army appears in the Mines. To make this Mercenary Camp join the lane behind allied Minions, capture it at 2:40 minutes or 10 seconds after a wave of Minions spawned. At 3:00 minutes and whenever the Undead Army spawns in the Mines, each team should decide how many Heroes to send inside the Mines depending on how much siege damage they have. If it is early game, the Offlaner can keep soaking. If you decide to play for the Objective, you should collect as many Cursed Skulls as possible from Risen Miners without going too far from the rest of your team. Then, if your team has an advantage, attack the Grave Golem. Otherwise, you can just leave the Mines and push a lane. If your team collected a lot more Cursed Skulls than the enemy team, your 4-man should push together with the allied Grave Golem. If it is early game, the Offlaner can keep soaking. If the enemy team collected a lot more Cursed Skulls than your team, your 4-man should defend allied Structures from the enemy Grave Golem. If it is early game, the Offlaner can keep soaking. If each team collected about the same amount of Cursed Skulls, the team with more siege damage should push and the other team should defend. If it is early game, the Offlaner can keep soaking.

sections.title: Mercenary Camps
sections.text: As shown in the image below, Haunted Mines has a total of 4 Mercenary Camps: 1 Sapper Camp (purple icon) near the center of the top lane; 1 Siege Camp (green icon) on the left side of the top lane; 1 Siege Camp (green icon) on the right side of the bottom lane; 1 Sapper Camp (purple icon) near the center of the bottom lane. Mercenary Camps on Haunted Mines are always active, even when the Mines are open or Grave Golems are in lane.

sections.title: Siege Camp
sections.text: This type of Mercenary Camp features 2 Siege Giants. Once captured, it spawns the same units fighting for your team in the corresponding lane. When possible, push with them to get more value. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 0:30 minutes 3:00 minutes after its last capture Baseline Experience Experience Scaling 280 Experience +4 Experience per minute (*) (*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute. Instead of attacking enemies with Basic Attacks, Siege Giants throw stones at them. These stones can be dodged, so it is possible to capture them without taking any damage. Once captured, they are capable of damaging enemy Structures without getting in their range. Siege Giants deal 100% bonus damage to Structures.

sections.title: Sapper Camp
sections.text: This type of Mercenary Camp features 3 Sappers. Once captured, it spawns the same units fighting for your team in the corresponding lane. When possible, push with them to get more value. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 0:30 minutes 2:30 minutes after its last capture Baseline Experience Experience Scaling 90 Experience +6 Experience per minute (*) (*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute. When in range of an enemy Structure, Sappers will sprint at it and explode. All enemy non-Heroes within 2.5 range will take damage form it. Structures will take 1750 damage (not scaling) and non-Structures will take 187 damage (not scaling). You can briefly interrupt the explosion by using Stun, Silence, or even Knockback effects. That said, if you do not kill them in time, they will try again immediately after.

sections.title: Watch Towers
sections.text:
Haunted Mines features 2 Watch Towers: they are located in the middle area, one near the left entrance to the Mines and another one near the right entrance to the Mines. If a team controls a Watch Tower, entering in the Mines from the corresponding entrance becomes more dangerous as the enemy team could see you walk outside and quickly prepare a trap inside.

Securing a Watch Tower provides your team with greater vision, allowing you to keep an eye on enemy movements in that part of the battlefield. Watch Towers can be captured by standing in the area until your team gains control. After 45 seconds of not being occupied, they become neutral again. Because of this, they should only be captured when you are playing in that area for other reasons (either to capture Mercenary Camps or for contesting the Objective). Watch Towers controlled by the enemy team are extremely dangerous, especially when there are bushes nearby. Therefore, you should think twice before contesting them. If you do not have mobility tools at your disposal and your teammates are not nearby to help you, you should definitely not try to capture a Watch Tower as you will only risk dying for no reason. Staying alive is more important than getting vision.

sections.title: Map Objective
sections.text:
The signature objective of Haunted Mines consists of an Undead Army composed of 8 groups of Risen Miners and 1 Grave Golem who drop Cursed Skulls. When active, each team has to collect 55 Cursed Skulls. Once a team does that, each team is rewarded with a laning Grave Golem. Their power is increased by the amount of Cursed Skulls collected by the corresponding team. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 3:00 2:00 minutes after the laning Grave Golems die

Venture Underground The Haunted Mines will periodically open with an Undead Army underneath. Collect the Skulls Destroy the Undead and collect their Skulls to power your Golems! Unleash the Golems After a team has collected 55 Skulls, the Golems will arise for both teams! The more Skulls your team collects, the stronger your Golem!

sections.title: Mines
sections.text:
To enter or leave the Mines, you need to interact with one of the 4 Mine Shafts or issue a movement command on the other section of the battlefield.

The entrances are located in the following places: 1 entrance in the middle of the top lane; 1 entrance near the Watch Tower on the right; 1 entrance near the Watch Tower on the left; 1 entrance in the middle of the bottom lane. Hero vision is reduced from 12 to 6.5 while inside the Mines. This means that you will not be able to see enemy Heroes as usual and that some Abilities will basically have reduced range unless there is an allied unit giving vision. While inside the Mines, some Heroes can use the surrounding impassable terrain at their advantage, to Stun enemy Heroes, to move faster, to block enemy Heroes, and/or to punish enemy Heroes who tend to group.

The exits are located in the following places: 1 exit at the top of the underground area; 1 exit on the right of the underground area; 1 exit at the bottom of the underground area; 1 exit on the left of the underground area. Be careful when using Mine Shafts to enter in or exit from the Mines. If enemy Heroes control a Watch Tower, they will have vision on the nearby Mine Shaft. This means they will be able to see who is entering and who just left the Mines.

sections.title: Undead Army
sections.text:
At the beginning of the Objective phase, 8 groups of Risen Miners and 1 Grave Golem will spawn in the Mines. They drop Cursed Skulls. The 8 groups of Risen Miners are spread around the Mines but they always spawn in the same locations. The underground Grave Golem always spawns in the center of the Mines.

To give you an overview, the Undead Army is arranged as follows: 2 groups of 5 Risen Miners on the top-right; 2 groups of 4 Risen Miners on the bottom-right; 2 groups of 5 Risen Miners on the bottom-left; 2 groups of 4 Risen Miners on the top-left; 1 underground Grave Golem in the center. In addition to dropping Cursed Skulls, the underground Grave Golem also drops Regeneration Globes when reaching 70% Health and 30% Health.

sections.title: Cursed Skulls
sections.text:
In the Mines there will always be 110 Cursed Skulls available for each Objective phase. Collect 55 Cursed Skulls before the enemy team does to get a stronger laning Grave Golem. Risen Miners drop 2 Cursed Skulls and are split into 8 groups of 4-5 Risen Miners. As a consequence, each group of Risen Miners will drop from 8 to 10 Cursed Skulls. The underground Grave Golem drops 8 Cursed Skulls for every 25% Health lost and 6 Cursed Skulls upon death, for a total of 38 Cursed Skulls.

To give you an overview, Cursed Skulls are distributed as follows: 2 groups of 10 Cursed Skulls on the top-right; 2 groups of 8 Cursed Skulls on the bottom-right; 2 groups of 10 Cursed Skulls on the bottom-left; 2 groups of 8 Cursed Skulls on the top-left; a total of 38 Cursed Skulls in the center. If both teams are collecting Cursed Skulls, each team will get about 4 groups of Risen Miners, which corresponds to at least 32 Cursed Skulls. This means that, in order to win the Objective, you need to kill enemy Heroes either before they collect Cursed Skulls from the other 4 groups of Risen Miners or to have numerical advantage for fighting the Grave Golem in the middle of the Mines and bring him down to 25% Health for getting a total of 24 Cursed Skulls.

sections.title: Grave Golems
sections.text: Once a team collects 55 Cursed Skulls, laning Grave Golems for each team will spawn in opposite lanes at the same time, starting randomly and then alternating for the rest of the game. You can see in which lanes they will spawn by looking at the glowing bones near the middle of each lane. The allied Grave Golem will spawn in the lane with the glowing bones closer to your Core whereas the enemy Grave Golem will spawn in the lane with the glowing bones further away from your Core. The power of the laning Grave Golems increases with Game Time and based on Cursed Skulls collected by the owners. The time-based scaling snapshots when both teams combined collect 60 Cursed Skulls. If both teams combined collect less than 60 Cursed Skulls, however, the time-based scaling snapshots when the Grave Golems spawn in lane. Once the time-based scaling has been applied, Cursed Skulls collected by the owners further increase the power of the laning Grave Golems by 7% each.

sections.title: Core Ability
sections.text: Contrary to all other Battlegrounds, there is no Core Ability on Haunted Mines.

sections.title: Win Conditions
sections.text: To win the game on Haunted Mines, you should count on any of the following win conditions: Map Objective.

sections.title: Tips and Tricks
sections.text: Use the first Healing Fountain (2-minute cooldown) before 1:00 minute. This is because the first Objective on this Map activates at 3:00 minutes, so you will have it back in time for that. Mines will open at 3:00 minutes into the game and never close again. You can use them for confusing enemy Heroes while fighting near Mine Shafts, or for moving across the battlefield without being seen from Watch Towers. The groups of Risen Miners in the top-right and bottom-left of the Mines drop 2 more Cursed Skulls than the others. If possible, collect them first. Then, if they have not been killed yet, move to the nearest groups of Risen Miners. If you move the camera to the center of the upper portion of the battlefield, you will be able to take a peek into the center of the Mines. This will allow you to see if enemy Heroes are fighting the Grave Golem. The laning Grave Golem takes about 30 seconds to spawn. You can use this time to capture the allied Siege Camp. This way, Siege Giants will damage the enemy Grave Golem or support the allied Grave Golem, depending on which lane they are on. Right before the laning Grave Golem spawns, you can try to crowd control enemy Heroes near the spawning location, so that they will get hit by his powerful Abilities. See our Map Guides page for further information »

sections.title: Introduction
sections.text: Infernal Shrines is a 3-lane Map belonging to the Diablo universe. The signature Objective of this Map are Shrines. When active, each team has to kill 40 Guardians. The first team who does that gets a Punisher, a powerful unit that will enable a strong push.

sections.title: Draft Strategy
sections.text: Prefer Double Healer Effects relying on impassable terrain Quests to stack on Heroes Strong late game High waveclear Avoid Weak late game See our Infernal Shrines Tier List page for further information »

sections.title: Lane Assignments
sections.text: Here you can find one or more formations that are viable on this Map. Keep in mind that positions in lane are not strict and will often change based on the situation.

sections.title: Formation 1-4
sections.text: The go-to formation for Infernal Shrines is 1-4: 1 Hero, the Offlaner, covers the top lane; 4 Heroes rotate between the middle and the bottom lane.

sections.title: Map Strategy
sections.text: At 0:30 minutes or whenever available, start clearing the allied Siege Camp in the middle lane and capture it as soon as possible. Watch out for invades! Someone should stay in the bush on the side, so that you can react faster when enemy Heroes arrive. After that, if your team has an advantage, start clearing the neutral Siege Camp in the bottom lane and capture it as soon as possible. At 2:15 minutes or 30-40 seconds before the next Objective phase, start clearing the allied Bruiser Camp and capture it slightly before the Shrine activates. To make this Mercenary Camp join the lane together with allied Minions, capture it at 2:40 minutes or 10 seconds after a wave of Minions spawned. At 3:00 minutes or right before the next Shrine activates, you must be already near the Shrine! Being late by just 5 seconds is enough to gift 10 Guardians to the enemy team. If you are 10 seconds late, the enemy team can easily get a lead of 20 Guardians and basically get a free Punisher. If it is the first Shrine of the game, the Offlaner can double soak during the Objective phase and while the Punisher is up. When the Objective is bottom, they should rotate between the middle and the top lane. When the Objective is middle or top, they should rotate between the middle and bottom lane. If you win the Objective, push together with the Punisher. The first thing you should do is to destroy a Side Wall (on the external side of the Towers surrounding the Gate) so that your team can use that space to make aggressive plays and/or to get out when caught by enemy Heroes. If you lose the Objective, fall back and kill the Punisher as quickly as possible without dying. Do not try to save Structures that have low Health as that will only give the enemy team an opportunity to dive.

sections.title: Mercenary Camps
sections.text: As shown in the image below, Infernal Shrines has a total of 5 Mercenary Camps: 2 Bruiser Camps (blue icon) in the top lane; 2 Siege Camps (green icon) in the middle lane; 1 Siege Camp (green icon) in the bottom lane. Mercenary Camps on Infernal Shrines are always active, even when a Shrine is up or when a Punisher is alive.

sections.title: Siege Camp
sections.text: This type of Mercenary Camp features 3 Impalers. Once captured, it spawns the same units fighting for your team in the corresponding lane. When possible, push with them to get more value. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 0:30 minutes 3:00 minutes after its last capture Baseline Experience Experience Scaling 270 Experience +6 Experience per minute (*) (*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute. Impalers are ranged units that can attack enemies from the distance but lack area of effect damage to quickly clear enemy Minions. Once captured, they are capable of damaging enemy Structures without getting in their range.

sections.title: Bruiser Camp
sections.text: This type of Mercenary Camp features 1 Fallen Shaman and 2 Fallen Hounds. Once captured, it spawns the same units fighting for your team in the corresponding lane. When possible, push with them to get more value. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 0:30 minutes 4:00 minutes after its last capture Baseline Experience Experience Scaling 450 Experience +6 Experience per minute (*) (*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute. Once captured, the Fallen Shaman periodically summons 2 Fallen Hounds whenever they die. The most efficient way to clear them in lane is therefore to kill the Fallen Shaman first and the Fallen Hounds after. Fallen Shaman and Fallen Hounds deal 100% increased damage to Minions, Structures and Summons.

sections.title: Map Objective
sections.text:
The signature Objective of Infernal Shrines are Shrines. When active, each team has to kill 40 Guardians. The first team who does that gets a Punisher, a powerful unit that will enable a strong push. Shrines also spawn 2 Regeneration Globes when completed. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 3:00 minutes 3:00 minutes after the Punisher dies

Activate the Shrines The Infernal Shrines periodically gather power. Activate them and prepare for a fight. Defeat Guardians Slay 40 Guardians before the enemy team to bring forth a mighty Punisher. Beware the Punisher Punishers have one of three devastating powers. Be careful, they focus on attacking heroes above all else.

sections.title: Shrines
sections.text: Shrines can be in 3 different locations: right above the top lane, right above the middle lane, and between the middle and the bottom lanes. 99% of the time, the Shrine will be in a different location from the previous one. Guardians have 20 Spell Armor and spawn in intervals of 0.15 seconds, until 10 of them exist. From that point, a 5-second timer starts, which triggers another spawn phase. Guardians follow enemies to attack them, so you can group them by moving around and then use area of effect Abilities to kill many of them at the same time. When doing so, be careful because enemy Heroes will try to steal them by last-hitting! You should try to do the same. The best Heroes for clearing the Shrine are: Alexstrasza with Dragonqueen; D.Va with a well-timed Self-Destruct; Hogger with a well-placed Hogg Wild; Tychus with Commandeer Odin.

sections.title: Punishers
sections.text: The type of Punisher will change every time, across 3 different types: Arcane (purple), placing rotating Arcane beams to damage enemies; Frost (blue), firing delayed frost bombs that Root enemies and disable Structures; Mortar (orange), launching a stream of firebombs to damage enemies. Punishers can jump on enemy Gates and Heroes, dealing damage and Stunning enemy Heroes hit. Punishers prioritize jumping on enemy Gates, so Heroes cannot bait them in while defending. Do not stand too close to the Gate or you will get hit by the jump!

sections.title: Core Ability
sections.text: Every 12 seconds, the Core will spawn 2 volleys of Frozen Orbs that explode, dealing 5% maximum Health as damage and Rooting enemy Heroes hit for 1.5 seconds.

sections.title: Win Conditions
sections.text: To win the game on Infernal Shrines, you should count on any of the following win conditions: Map Objective, Split-push.

sections.title: Tips and Tricks
sections.text: Use the first Healing Fountain (2-minute cooldown) before 1:00 minute because the first Objective on this Map activates at 3:00 minutes, so you will have it back in time for that. Look at the color of the Shrine or mouseover a Shrine indicator on the Minimap to see whether the next Punisher will be a Mortar (orange), Frost (blue), or Arcane (purple) one. 39-ing the Objective (stopping at 39 Guardians killed) is a strategy used to delay a Punisher spawn when your team has an advantage and the enemy team killed little to no Guardians. Use it to wait for allied Heroes to respawn, for the next Talent Tier to be unlocked, or even for creating a Talent Tier advantage during the next Objective phase. Punishers can jump on enemy Gates and Heroes, dealing damage and Stunning enemy Heroes hit. Punishers prioritize jumping on enemy Gates, so Heroes cannot bait them in while defending. Do not stand too close to the Gate or you will get hit by the jump! Global Heroes should ideally take care of the lane that is farther away from the next Objective location, so that they can use their global tool to quickly join their team during the next Objective phase. See our Map Guides page for further information »

sections.title: Introduction
sections.text: Sky Temple is a 3-lane Map belonging to the Nexus universe. The signature Objective of this Map are Temples. When active, Heroes can stand on them to fire laser shots at enemy Structures.

sections.title: Draft Strategy
sections.text: Prefer Heroes for clearing Mercenary Camps Gankers Global presence Point control for Boss Camp Split-push Avoid Quests to stack on Heroes See our Sky Temple Tier List page for further information »

sections.title: Lane Assignments
sections.text: Here you can find one or more formations that are viable on this Map. Keep in mind that positions in lane are not strict and will often change based on the situation.

sections.title: Formation 1-4
sections.text: The go-to formation for Sky Temple is 1-4: 1 Hero, the Offlaner, covers the top lane; 4 Heroes rotate between the middle and the bottom lane.

sections.title: Formation 1-3-1
sections.text: Another good formation for Sky Temple is 1-3-1: 1 Hero, the Offlaner, covers the top lane; 3 Heroes cover the middle lane and roam as soon as possible; 1 Hero, the Anchor, covers the bottom lane.

sections.title: Map Strategy
sections.text: At 0:30 minutes, start clearing the allied Bruiser Camp, capture it as soon as possible, and push with it. To make this Mercenary Camp join the lane in front of allied Minions, capture it at 1:05 or 5 seconds after a wave of Minions spawned. At 2:20 minutes, start clearing the allied Siege Camp and capture it slightly before the next Objective phase starts. To make this Mercenary Camp join the lane behind allied Minions, capture it at 2:50 minutes or 20 seconds after a wave of Minions spawned. At 3:00 minutes or whenever the Objective phase starts, you ideally want at least 1 Hero on each Temple, so that you can start shooting at enemy Structures right away. If possible, prioritize the top Temple as a 4-man while the Offlaner keeps soaking other lanes. When the top Temple is NOT going to activate and the next Objective phase is approaching, start clearing the allied Bruiser Camp and capture it slightly before the Temples activate. Otherwise, start clearing the allied Bruiser Camp and capture it as soon as possible. To make this Mercenary Camp join the lane in front of allied Minions, capture it 5 seconds after a wave of Minions spawned. When the bottom Temple is NOT going to activate and the next Objective phase is approaching, start clearing the allied Siege Camp and capture it slightly before the Temples activate. Otherwise, start clearing the allied Bruiser Camp and capture it as soon as possible. To make this Mercenary Camp join the lane behind allied Minions, capture it 20 seconds after a wave of Minions spawned. When ahead in Structures (your team has more of them) or when you want to wait for a better moment to fight, trade Temples (when multiple Temples are active, contest one and ignore the other) and avoid team fights. Do not split too much from the rest of your team, otherwise you will become an easy target! When behind in Structures (the enemy team has more of them), gank someone or force a fight at some point. That said, you should avoid fighting if the enemy team has an advantage, except when that is your last chance to stop them from winning the game. After about 10:00 minutes, whenever your team has an advantage while there is no Objective to contest or the enemy team is taking the top Temple, you can capture the Boss Camp and push with it. Avoid doing it earlier if you do not have a dedicated team composition.

sections.title: Mercenary Camps
sections.text:
As shown in the image below, Sky Temple has a total of 5 Mercenary Camps: 2 Bruiser Camps (blue icon) in the top lane; 2 Siege Camps (green icon) in the bottom lane; 1 Boss Camp (red icon) in the bottom lane. Mercenary Camps on Sky Temple are always active, even when Temples are available on the battlefield.

Mercenary Camps indicated with a red icon are immune to Bribe effects.

sections.title: Siege Camp
sections.text: This type of Mercenary Camp features 2 Siege Giants. Once captured, it spawns the same units fighting for your team in the corresponding lane. When possible, push with them to get more value. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 0:30 minutes 3:00 minutes after its last capture Baseline Experience Experience Scaling 280 Experience +4 Experience per minute (*) (*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute. Instead of attacking enemies with Basic Attacks, Siege Giants throw stones at them. These stones can be dodged, so it is possible to capture them without taking any damage. Once captured, they are capable of damaging enemy Structures without getting in their range. Siege Giants deal 100% bonus damage to Structures.

sections.title: Bruiser Camp
sections.text: This type of Mercenary Camp features 3 Knights and 1 Wizard. Once captured, it spawns the same units fighting for your team in the corresponding lane. When possible, push with them to get more value. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 0:30 minutes 4:00 minutes after its last capture Baseline Experience Experience Scaling 450 Experience +9 Experience per minute (*) (*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute. Right after being captured and while in lane, the Wizard creates a Spell Armor field around him which reduces some of the damage taken by Minions, Mercenaries, and Heroes within range. Avoid fighting the enemy team if they still have a Wizard helping them!

sections.title: Boss Camp
sections.text: This type of Mercenary Camp features 1 Sand Golem. Once captured, it spawns the same unit fighting for your team in the corresponding lane. When possible, push with it to get more value. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 5:00 minutes 5:00 minutes after its last capture Baseline Experience Experience Scaling 750 Experience +10 Experience per minute (*) (*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute. While in combat, the Sand Golem will use Mega Smash (10-second cooldown) to damage and Stun all enemies in melee range and Whirling Sands (15-second cooldown) to do slight damage and Knockback enemies who get hit by them. Due to being Elite, this Mercenary Camp is immune to Bribe effects (such as Covert Mission by Nova).

sections.title: Map Objective
sections.text:
The signature Objective of Sky Temple consists of up to 2 active Temples. Heroes who stand on a non-contested Temple will cause that Temple to fire laser shots at the closest Structures (excluding Healing Fountains, because they are Invulnerable, and Side Walls). Temples will activate 2 seconds after a Hero steps on them, then they will fire once per second over 40 seconds, pausing when contested or abandoned. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 3:00 minutes 2:00 minutes after the Temples end

Capture the Temples Temples will periodically awaken. Stand within their grounds to capture their power! Hold the Temples Remain firm and the temple will unleash a blistering onslaught on your enemy's forts! Defend the Temples Guardians will try to wrest control of their temples from your team. Hold them off to keep the temple's power for yourselves!

sections.title: Temples
sections.text: Each Temple has a total of 40 shots plus 5 bonus shots that each deal 450 (+20 per minute) damage. The 5 bonus shots will fire automatically and in rapid succession for the team that currently has possession of the Temple once the first 40 shots have been expended. When leaving a Temple, it will always fire 2 more shots before stopping to shoot. This means that Heroes can leave a Temple at 2 shots remaining to automatically fire the 2 last shots and the 5 bonus shots without wasting time. A contested Temple, with Heroes from both teams on it, does not shoot. Each Temple is initially protected by 1 Guardian and 2 Defenders, then other 2 Defenders spawn. Guardians can Knockback enemies who are in a frontal cone once every 12 seconds. Even though it is not required to kill Guardians and Defenders, by doing so you will take less damage while capturing the Temple. When killed, Guardians will drop a Regeneration Globe but Defenders will not. You should prefer to kill the Defenders that are on your side first, so that you will take less damage whenever enemy Heroes come. After a Temple has been exhausted, Guardians and Defenders will automatically despawn. Temples will spawn as follows: top Temple and middle Temple; bottom Temple only; top Temple and bottom Temple, or middle Temple and bottom Temple; 1 random Temple, or 1 random Temple and the missing Temple from the previous Objective phase; up to 2 random Temples, but in a different amount from the previous Objective phase; up to 2 random Temples, trying to reach a total of 3-2-2 or 2-3-2 spawns for the respective Temple locations.

sections.title: Watch Towers
sections.text:
Sky Temple features 1 Watch Tower located between the middle lane and the top lane, giving vision on the middle Temple and on the fastest paths to rotate between the middle and the top lane.

Securing a Watch Tower provides your team with greater vision, allowing you to keep an eye on enemy movements in that part of the battlefield. Watch Towers can be captured by standing in the area until your team gains control. After 45 seconds of not being occupied, they become neutral again. Because of this, they should only be captured when you are playing in that area for other reasons (either to capture Mercenary Camps or for contesting the Objective). Watch Towers controlled by the enemy team are extremely dangerous, especially when there are bushes nearby, therefore you should think twice before contesting them. If you do not have mobility tools at your disposal and your teammates are not nearby to help you, you should definitely not try to capture a Watch Tower as you will only risk dying for no reason. Staying alive is more important than getting vision.

sections.title: Core Ability
sections.text: Every 23 seconds, the Core will spawn 2 sets of 6 Tornadoes which swirl around it, dealing 25 damage to enemy Heroes and Knocking them back.

sections.title: Win Conditions
sections.text: To win the game on Sky Temple, you should count on any of the following win conditions: Map Objective, Boss Camp, Split-push.

sections.title: Tips and Tricks
sections.text: Use the first Healing Fountain (2-minute cooldown) before 1:00 minute because the first Objective on this Map activates at 3:00 minutes, so you will have it back in time for that. Dealing damage to Structures in the top lane before the first Objective phase helps to take down the top Fort with the top Temple during the first Objective phase. When successfully executed, this move gives you an advantage during the second Objective phase by creating pressure in the top lane. If you destroy the top Fort by pushing with the Bruiser Camp in the top lane and by securing the top Temple during the first Objective phase, you will create pressure in the top lane during the second Objective phase by using the Bruiser Camp again and by having a Catapult every third wave in the top lane. During the first Objective phase it is fine to get only 1 of the 2 Temples, especially if your team composition has a weak early game. During the second Objective phase, it is important to win because there will be only 1 Temple. After that, trade Temples and avoid fighting when ahead in Structures (your team has more of them) and look for fights when behind in Structures (the enemy team has more of them). You can leave a Temple at 2 shots remaining. Temples do not stop shooting immediately, but always fire 2 additional shots before stopping. When the are no more shots left, you automatically get the 5 bonus shots from that Temple right after the last shot. After about 10:00 minutes, unless the enemy team has an advantage, it is advised to keep vision on the Boss Camp, so that the enemy team cannot capture it uncontested. You can do this by using a Hero that is hard to kill or with vision tools (for example Time Trap by Chromie). You can bait the Sand Golem's Whirling Sands on the enemy side of the battlefield by staying there right before they spawn. This way, if the enemy team invades the Boss Camp, they will have annoying tornadoes on their path. Global Heroes should ideally take care of the lane that is farther away from the next Objective location, so that they can use their global tool to quickly join their team during the next Objective phase. See our Map Guides page for further information »

sections.title: Introduction
sections.text: Tomb of the Spider Queen is a 3-lane Map belonging to the Nexus universe. The signature Objective of this Map are Webweavers. One per lane, they will fight alongside the team who pays the required amount of Gems, dealing heavy damage to enemy Structures on their way.

sections.title: Draft Strategy
sections.text: Prefer Effects relying on impassable terrain Poke tools for Objective Quests to stack on Heroes Strong late game Sustain damage/healing Vision tools High waveclear Avoid Weak late game Low waveclear Effects relying on bushes See our Tomb of the Spider Queen Tier List page for further information »

sections.title: Lane Assignments
sections.text: Here you can find one or more formations that are viable on this Map. Keep in mind that positions in lane are not strict and will often change based on the situation.

sections.title: Formation 4-1
sections.text: The go-to formation for Tomb of the Spider Queen is 4-1: 4 Heroes rotate between the middle and the top lane; 1 Hero, the Offlaner, covers the bottom lane.

sections.title: Map Strategy
sections.text: At 0:30 minutes, you could try to sneak-capture the neutral Siege Camp in the bottom lane with the help of a second Hero that you sent there beforehand. While doing so, do not play for the allied Bruiser Camp in the middle lane because they may need your help in the bottom lane. At 0:30 minutes or right before a team gets Webweavers, start clearing the allied Bruiser Camp in the middle lane and capture it as soon as possible. To make this Mercenary Camp join the lane in front of allied Minions, capture it at 1:05 minutes or 5 seconds after a wave of Minions spawned. After that, if your team has an advantage, start clearing the neutral Siege Camp in the bottom lane and capture it as soon as possible. When your team has enough Gems, prepare waves to be even vertically and pay to get Webweavers. When paying, someone should give vision in nearby bushes so you don't get caught by surprise and lose all your Gems. When the enemy team has enough Gems, ruin waves to not be even vertically and stop the enemy Hero who is carrying the highest amount of Gems from paying, however, be careful not to die in the process because having a numerical disadvantage will only make defending from Webweavers harder. After about 10:00 minutes, whenever your team has an advantage or right after all allied Webweavers have been killed, you can pay Gems and capture the Boss Camp at the same time by taking aggro of the Boss while paying the last few Gems, and then push with them. Avoid doing it earlier if you do not have a dedicated team composition.

sections.title: Mercenary Camps
sections.text:
As shown in the image below, Tomb of the Spider Queen has a total of 4 Mercenary Camps: 1 Boss Camp (red icon) in the top lane; 2 Bruiser Camps (blue icon) in the middle lane; 1 Siege Camp (green icon) in the bottom lane. Mercenary Camps on Tomb of the Spider Queen disappear from the battlefield once the Webweavers begin spawning (unless their Mercenaries are in combat) and reappear only after all Webweavers have been killed.

Mercenary Camps indicated with a red icon are immune to Bribe effects.

sections.title: Siege Camp
sections.text: This type of Mercenary Camp features 2 Siege Giants. Once captured, it spawns the same units fighting for your team in the corresponding lane. When possible, push with them to get more value. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 0:30 minutes 3:00 minutes after its last capture Baseline Experience Experience Scaling 280 Experience +4 Experience per minute (*) (*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute. Instead of attacking enemies with Basic Attacks, Siege Giants throw stones at them. These stones can be dodged, so it is possible to capture them without taking any damage. Once captured, they are capable of damaging enemy Structures without getting in their range. Siege Giants deal 100% bonus damage to Structures.

sections.title: Bruiser Camp
sections.text: This type of Mercenary Camp features 3 Knights and 1 Wizard. Once captured, it spawns the same units fighting for your team in the corresponding lane. When possible, push with them to get more value. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 0:30 minutes 4:00 minutes after its last capture Baseline Experience Experience Scaling 450 Experience +9 Experience per minute (*) (*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute. Right after being captured and while in lane, the Wizard creates a Spell Armor field around him which reduces some of the damage taken by Minions, Mercenaries, and Heroes within range. Avoid fighting the enemy team if they still have a Wizard helping them!

sections.title: Boss Camp
sections.text: This type of Mercenary Camp features 1 Sand Golem. Once captured, it spawns the same unit fighting for your team in the corresponding lane. When possible, push with it to get more value. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 5:00 minutes 5:00 minutes after its last capture Baseline Experience Experience Scaling 750 Experience +10 Experience per minute (*) (*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute. While in combat, the Sand Golem will use Mega Smash (10-second cooldown) to damage and Stun all enemies in melee range and Whirling Sands (15-second cooldown) to do slight damage and Knockback enemies who get hit by them. Due to being Elite, this Mercenary Camp is immune to Bribe effects (such as Covert Mission by Nova).

sections.title: Map Objective
sections.text:
The signature Objective of Tomb of the Spider Queen consists of 3 Webweavers that spawn after paying enough Gems. In order to pay, Heroes have to channel for 6 seconds. Whenever a team pays enough Gems, after a 15-second delay, a Webweaver will spawn in each lane. Webweavers can use Death Wave (7-second cooldown and 4-second channel), a powerful Ability to deal damage in front of them, and Spawn Minions (20-second cooldown), which summons 2 Cryptcrawlers. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 30 seconds 15 seconds after the Webweavers die

Collect Gems Enemy spider minions and Heroes drop magical gems upon death. Gather as many as you can! Turn in Gems Relinquish your gems at one of the Spider Queen's altars or you will drop them all when you die! Summon Webweavers Whichever team turns in enough gems first will unleash the Webweavers to destroy their enemy's defenses.

sections.title: Gems
sections.text: You need 50 Gems to pay, plus 5 Gems for each time your team already got Webweavers during the game. If your team has enough Gems to pay, the Gems counter (under the Minimap) for your team will glow. Ranged Minions, Murky, The Lost Vikings, and Misha drop 1 Gem. All other enemy Heroes drop 3 Gems. Heroes can carry a maximum of 100 Gems. Gems are lost on death, but allied Heroes have 8 seconds to pick them up from the ground before they disappear. Keep in mind that enemy Heroes can see where they are, so smart opponents will try to zone you away from them. Right before winning the Objective, you should ideally prepare waves so that allied Webweavers reach enemy Structures at the same time in every lane and thus the enemy team cannot easily defend them one at a time. Similarly, right before losing the Objective, you can ruin waves to weaken enemy Webweavers.

sections.title: Core Ability
sections.text: Every 5 seconds, the Core will shoot a Death Wave, dealing 5% maximum Health as damage to enemy Heroes and Slowing them by 70% for 1.25 seconds.

sections.title: Win Conditions
sections.text: To win the game on Tomb of the Spider Queen, you should count on any of the following win conditions: Map Objective, Boss Camp.

sections.title: Tips and Tricks
sections.text: On this Map, due to the Objective being always active, you can use the Healing Fountain on cooldown instead of saving it for when the Objective spawns. You do not need to use your Mount while rotating between the middle and the top lane because they are very close to each other. Movement Speed effects (notably Crossfade - Speed Boost by Lucio) help with that. Every time you have 10 Gems or more, pay to avoid losing them on death. Gems that fall on the ground and are not collected in time will be lost forever, causing your team to get fewer Webweavers throughout the game. You can press Tab to see who has the highest amount of Gems among enemy Heroes. Use that information to not let that Hero pay while your team does or to kill them when no other enemy Heroes are nearby to pick up their lost Gems. If your team has an advantage and enough Gems to get Webweavers, you can aggro the Boss while the last few Gems are being paid. By keeping the Boss in combat, the Boss Camp does not disappear from the battlefield while Webweavers are alive, so you can clear it and capture it while Webweavers are spawning and then push with Webweavers and Boss at the same time. You can bait the Sand Golem's Whirling Sands on the enemy side of the battlefield by staying there right before they spawn. This way, if the enemy team invades the Boss Camp, they will have annoying tornadoes on their path. See our Map Guides page for further information »

sections.title: Introduction
sections.text: Towers of Doom is a 3-lane Map belonging to the Nexus universe. The signature Objective of this Map are Altars. Cores have 40 Health and cannot be attacked directly. When captured, Altars deal 1 damage to the enemy Core, increased by 1 for each Bell Tower (Fort or Keep) under your team's control. Bring the enemy Core to 0 Health to win the game.

sections.title: Draft Strategy
sections.text: Prefer Heroes for clearing Mercenary Camps Gankers Global presence Offlaner who can double soak Poke tools for Objective Strong late game Avoid Core backdoor Weak late game See our Towers of Doom Tier List page for further information »

sections.title: Lane Assignments
sections.text: Here you can find one or more formations that are viable on this Map. Keep in mind that positions in lane are not strict and will often change based on the situation.

sections.title: Formation 1-4
sections.text: The go-to formation for Towers of Doom is 1-4: 1 Hero, the Offlaner, double-soaks the middle and top lanes; 4 Heroes cover the bottom lane.

sections.title: Formation 1-1-3
sections.text: Another good formation for Towers of Doom is 1-1-3: 1 Hero, the Offlaner, covers the top lane; 1 Hero covers the middle lane and ganks when possible; 3 Heroes cover the bottom lane.

sections.title: Map Strategy
sections.text: At 0:30 minutes or whenever available, start clearing the allied Sapper Camp and capture it as soon as possible. Watch out for invades! Someone should stay in the bush on the side, so that you can react faster when enemy Heroes arrive. At 3:00 minutes or whenever the next Objective phase starts, make sure to have at least 1 Hero near each allied and neutral Altar. Avoid trying to capture the enemy Altar (the one that is near the top lane and on the enemy side), but feel free to poke whoever is trying to capture it. Send a global Hero to capture the allied Altar (the one that is near the top lane and on the allied side) if you have one. If you manage to capture the bottom Bell Tower (Fort or Keep), defend it! You do not want the enemy team to get it back for free before the next Objective phase, especially if there will be one or more Altars nearby. If the enemy team manages to capture the bottom Bell Tower (Fort or Keep) and you struggle to get it back, start clearing the neutral Sapper Camp and capture it as soon as possible, then push in the middle and/or top lane. In the late game, whenever you have a big advantage (at least 3 enemy Heroes are dead), go for a 6-cap: quickly split your team in a way that will cause all enemy Bell Towers (Forts and Keeps) to be captured at the same time. Do not capture the Boss Camp unless your team has an advantage and the enemy Core has 4 Health or less, or the enemy team can use it to win the game during the next Objective phase. In all other cases it is better to deal damage to enemy Structures.

sections.title: Mercenary Camps
sections.text:
As shown in the image below, Towers of Doom has a total of 4 Mercenary Camps: 1 Sapper Camp (purple icon) in the top lane; 1 Boss Camp (red icon) between the top and the middle lanes; 2 Sapper Camps (purple icon) in the bottom lane. Mercenary Camps on Towers of Doom are always active, even when Altars are available on the battlefield.

Mercenary Camps indicated with a red icon are immune to Bribe effects.

sections.title: Sapper Camp
sections.text: This type of Mercenary Camp features 3 Sappers. Once captured, it spawns the same units fighting for your team in the corresponding lane. When possible, push with them to get more value. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 0:30 minutes 2:30 minutes after its last capture Baseline Experience Experience Scaling 90 Experience +6 Experience per minute (*) (*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute. When in range of an enemy Structure, Sappers will sprint at it and explode. All enemy non-Heroes within 2.5 range will take damage form it. Structures will take 1750 damage (not scaling) and non-Structures will take 187 damage (not scaling). You can briefly interrupt the explosion by using Stun, Silence, or even Knockback effects. That said, if you do not kill them in time, they will try again immediately after. Sappers on Towers of Doom have an additional effect: if they enter in the enemy team's Kill Zone, they will launch their head at their Core, dealing 1 point of damage regardless of how many Bell Towers (Forts or Keeps) are under your team's control. Therefore, fully escorting a Sapper Camp will deal 3 damage to the enemy Core.

sections.title: Boss Camp
sections.text: This type of Mercenary Camp features 1 Headless Horseman. Once captured, instead of going in lane, he vanishes and deals 4 damage to the enemy Core, regardless of how many Bell Towers (Forts and Keeps) are under your team's control. The damage happens after 5 seconds, over 2 seconds. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 5:00 minutes 5:00 minutes after its last capture Baseline Experience Experience Scaling 375 Experience +10 Experience per minute (*) (*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute. Headless Horseman's Basic Attacks cleave for 100% of the damage in a half-circle in front of him. While in combat, the Headless Horseman will use Horseman's Head (6-second cooldown) to fire a skull that spins around him for a couple of seconds and then hits the ground under an enemy Hero, creating a green pool that deals a lot of damage. Due to being Elite, this Mercenary Camp is immune to Bribe effects (such as Covert Mission by Nova).

sections.title: Waygate
sections.text: Towers of Doom has a Waygate connecting each Core to the middle of the battlefield. When clicking on it, after channeling for 2 seconds, you will be teleported near the bush in the middle lane. You cannot use the Waygate in the early game because it is closed. The passage usually opens at 12:00 minutes but it is delayed if there are Altars active. Once accessible, the tunnel can be used to quickly join the action after dying or using the Hearthstone, but cannot be used to go back to base. Be careful when standing near the exit because multiple enemy Heroes could suddenly get out from the tunnel and kill you.

sections.title: Map Objective
sections.text:
The signature Objective of Towers of Doom consists of Altars. In order to capture an Altar, Heroes have to channel for 6 seconds. When captured, Altars deal 1 damage to the enemy Core, increased by 1 for each Bell Tower (Fort or Keep) under your team's control. The damage happens after 4 seconds. Spawn Time Respawn Delay 3:00 minutes 1:50 minutes after capturing all Altars

Protected Cores Both Cores are protected by a barrier that cannot be attacked by Heroes. To be victorious, you must activate Altars. Activate Altars Periodically Altars will rise across the battlefield. Activate them to have your Bell Towers fire upon the enemy's Core.
